note: PO defines the spikelet and its parts (glume, lemma, palea, lodicule, awn) for the grasses; the sedge-like families use the same words by convention. In other families "awn" (Asteraceae pappus, Geraniaceae fruit, moss leaf), "palea" (Asteraceae receptacle) and "spikelet" (Amaranthaceae) are other organs.
